zh-CN.name: 粗野主义
zh-CN.description: 网页语境中的粗野主义常以直接、少装饰、暴露结构的视觉表达呈现内容。它与故意让人无法操作的反设计并不相同，也不同于建筑材料意义上的粗野主义。
use_when: 品牌表达适合直接的结构与文字。
内容本身比精细装饰更重要。
avoid_when: 不能把破坏导航与可访问性当作风格要求。
重要操作仍需要一致、可识别的入口。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
用直接排版、简单表面和清楚的结构展示内容，弱化无关装饰；保留可读层级、可靠导航和一致链接样式；形式可以朴素，交互反馈和键盘操作不能缺失。
专属演示：直接的文档排版、实线分隔与原生可点击链接；切换章节展示真实导航。 参数：正文字号 {font_size_px}px。

en.name: Brutalism
en.description: In web design, brutalism often presents content through direct, minimally decorated and visibly structural composition. It is distinct from deliberately unusable antidesign and from the architectural meaning of the term.
use_when: The brand suits direct structure and typography.
Content matters more than decorative polish.
avoid_when: Do not treat broken navigation or accessibility as stylistic requirements.
Important actions still need consistent, recognizable entry points.
en.prompt_template:
Present content with direct typography, simple surfaces and clear structure while reducing unrelated decoration. Preserve readable hierarchy, dependable navigation and consistent links. The appearance can be raw, but feedback and keyboard interaction must remain usable.
Dedicated demonstration: Direct document typography, solid separators and operable links; section changes demonstrate real navigation. Parameters: body size {font_size_px}px.
